carla: Heads-up from today's resilience run: region failover hit an artifact ABI mismatch and aborted.
yun: error log?
carla: ```
ArtifactLoadError: abi_version_mismatch
 expected: 2.1.0
 found: 1.9.7
```
ben: This is toolchain/driver ABI drift, not quantization. We kept older builders for some Dedicated pools.
tess: So copying artifacts across regions can fail. Any customer residency constraints make copying illegal.
omar: legal-bot: If cross-border artifact movement is intended, file a legal review.
yun: Short-term mitigation: proxy preflight to check artifact.manifest. If ABI mismatch -> do NOT auto-forward; route to local smaller model or return degraded response with header `X-Redwood-Degraded: abi_incompat`.
ben: Long-term options: (A) publish multiple compiled artifacts per ABI in registry, (B) portable IR + in-region compile, (C) unify builder/toolchains.
tess: Manifest should include `artifact_abi`, `checksum`, `restrictions`. Runtime can make decisions quickly.
omar: ops-bot: will pause cross-region failover tests for affected model until preflight flag is on.
yun: I'll draft RFC with short-term block policy, required telemetry (`artifact.abi_mismatch`), runbook, and roadmap. ETA 48h.
carla: Thanks — cc ops + legal on the RFC. End of thread.
